description: Use this when the user asks what a clip says, what is on screen at a particular moment, which caption contains a word or a typo, or who said something. It is also the only way to get a caption's id, so read it first whenever a later step needs to name one caption. Narrow with at_seconds, a from/to range, or contains. Do not use for a transcript made with transcribe_audio, or to find clips (use get_episode).

at_seconds.description: Only the caption(s) on screen at this moment, in seconds.

clip_id.description: A made clip's clip_id, from get_episode or get_job.

contains.description: Only captions containing this text. Case-insensitive.

from_seconds.description: Start of a time range, in seconds.

include_removed.description: Include captions the editor has removed. They are not in the video. Default false.

to_seconds.description: End of a time range, in seconds.

name: read_captions
title: Read captions on a clip
